summary: Verified the cross-device public-status sync fix. Backend endpoints (POST/GET /api/public-sync, POST /api/public-sync/{ticket}/rating) all pass 11/11 pytest cases. Frontend cross-device test PASSES: admin change on KK-2501-005 propagates to a fresh browser context so PublicStatus shows 'Ready for Pickup' (bug reported by user is FIXED). Auto-poll on PublicStatus is confirmed: chip updates within 2-4s when server data changes (validated by direct server POST + fresh context). Rating flow end-to-end via /api/public-sync/{ticket}/rating works — thank-you card appears and server persists rating. LUNAS badge and rating-form gating still correct. Refresh button works. One flakiness note: admin status-button clicks in Playwright occasionally do not persist to localStorage (toast fires but store unchanged), likely a UI interaction/timing issue — verified with direct server POST instead.

ui_bugs.issue: Under automated Playwright interaction, clicking [data-testid=btn-status-*] sometimes shows the success toast but does NOT persist the new status to localStorage (and therefore fireSync never runs). Reproducible on repeated clicks in same session; the first click in a session does work. Likely a stale closure or double-mount race in the RepairDetail refresh flow. Real users clicking manually are unlikely to hit this often, but the failure mode is silent (toast lies).

action_items: Investigate the RepairDetail 'silent no-op' click issue: updateStatus() shows the success toast but the underlying store change appears not to persist under repeated clicks. Consider making updateStatus verify the return value of repairsApi.changeStatus and re-throw/reload on mismatch.
Optional: expose a dev-only debug hook (e.g. window.__kk_repairs) to make future E2E debugging easier.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: submit_public_rating returns 400 for missing ticket only after status check — good, but consider returning 404 first (currently already 404 due to explicit check).

publicSync.js: silent failure on POST is fine for admin app, but ensureSeed's onlyIfNew push and the changeStatus fireSync share the same error swallow — you may want a console.warn when a fireSync fails in production so real cross-device drift is diagnosable.

success_rate.frontend: 90% — cross-device bug FIXED; auto-poll verified via server POST; admin-UI click flakiness noted

seed_data_creation: Created transient tickets TEST-*, KK-TEST-*, POLL-* in db.public_repairs during tests. KK-2501-005/006 in public_repairs collection also touched (status may be 'ready' / 'in_progress' after this iteration; server value is authoritative for public page).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The user-reported bug ('public page still shows In Progress after admin set Ready for Pickup') is FIXED. Verified live in a fresh isolated context. Backend endpoints in /app/backend/server.py:107-169 are solid. Public polling in PublicStatus.jsx picks up server changes within 4s. If retesting the admin-click flakiness, watch that repairsApi.changeStatus actually persists to localStorage.kk_repairs — in this iteration, the first click after login/mount worked, subsequent clicks intermittently did not update the store despite toast success. Use browser fetch for admin-side simulation to avoid Playwright click timing issues when validating polling.
rca_of_the_issue: Original user bug root cause: mock store was localStorage-only, so any device without prior localStorage saw stale seed. Fix mirrors every repair mutation into MongoDB via /api/public-sync/{ticket_no} and PublicStatus polls it every 4s. Verified end-to-end in fresh isolated browser context. Remaining minor concern: admin-side status click intermittently no-ops silently — needs investigation but does NOT affect the reported bug once a status change actually goes through.
